What Sprouts is

Sprouts is an app for Solana Mobile phones. It rounds up every swap your linked wallets make and plants the spare change once a day, from the USDC in that wallet, into SKR staking, stORE, hSOL, cbBTC, and USDC and SOL lending at Kamino or Jupiter Lend. Your split decides where it goes, or the Yield Manager tunes it. Everything lands in your own wallet and shows as a painted garden.

Sprouts is not a bank

Sprouts is not a bank and not an exchange. Your garden is not a deposit. It is not insured by any government or private scheme. Nothing in Sprouts guarantees a return. Rates change and can fall to zero. The dollar value of your garden can be lower than what you put in.

Who can use Sprouts

You must be 18 or older, or the age of majority where you live if that is higher. You must be allowed to use services like this where you live. You need a Solana Mobile phone (Seeker or Saga) that holds a Genesis Token. One account per phone. Some venues restrict some places. You are responsible for following the laws that apply to you where you live, including tax on anything your garden earns.

Your money stays in your wallet

Sprouts never takes custody of your savings, except the small remainders described below. Your SKR is staked in Solana Mobile's staking program under your phone's key. Your stORE, hSOL and cbBTC sit in your own wallet, not locked. Your lending positions are receipts held by your own wallet at Kamino or Jupiter Lend. Sprouts cannot sell, move or withdraw any of it.

Small remainders from rounding and swaps can sit in the shared planting account until your next planting of that coin. They are credited to you and added to that planting.

When you link a wallet, you give Sprouts a daily limit of $5 in USDC, which our server pulls to plant your round-up. You can set a lower limit in the app. Our server keeps to it. The limit on chain stays $5.

New links go through the Sprouts program on Solana (the leash). It gives a stronger promise: "Even if our server is hacked, it can only move your daily round-up (max $5) into your own savings. Never anywhere else."

The precise rule: once your wallet is on the leash, Sprouts' server can only pull through the Sprouts program: at most your $5 daily limit, and only in a transaction that leaves at least 98.5% of that value (99.4% for USDC lending), at a live Pyth price where the coin has one (USDC lending is valued at $1 against the venue's own rate), in the coins Sprouts has enabled, lending positions or SKR stake. Otherwise the transaction reverts. The server still chooses when, which coin and how much up to the limit. Only Sprouts' admin key, which is never on our server, can change these rules or replace the program. Your $5-a-day limit still holds.

What linking a wallet authorises

Linking grants an on-chain allowance to pull at most $5 per day in USDC from that wallet. A new link grants it through the Sprouts program, which enforces the rule above on chain. You can pause a wallet in Settings at any time, and you can revoke the allowance on chain at any time. Revoking ends Sprouts' approval. Nothing in your garden moves.

Wallets linked before the leash went live keep their old allowance on chain. It is granted to our server directly, with no program in between. It stays until you re-link or revoke it. Those old links no longer plant. The app asks you to re-link to keep planting.

Your first planting comes within the hour once $0.50 is waiting. If your wallet cannot cover all the waiting change, Sprouts plants the round-ups it covers, oldest first. The rest wait for a top-up. A wallet too low for the smallest planting is paused, and it resumes on its own once it can cover one again. A pause you make yourself stays until you resume it.

Taking money out

You can withdraw any time. You sign every withdrawal on your phone.

  • SKR: unstaking takes 48 hours. You can cancel and put it back during the wait. After the 48 hours, our server delivers it to your wallet. The smallest withdrawal is 1 SKR.
  • Lending: you can withdraw part or all of a position. A venue can pause withdrawals when its pool is fully lent out. You can withdraw once borrowers repay or new money comes in.
  • A coin withdrawn to zero leaves your garden. If you plant it again, it starts again from a seedling.

The Yield Manager

Each planting buys one coin: the one furthest below its share of your split. Over time your garden moves toward your split. Your first plantings can all go to one coin. Coins join your garden as it grows: the first $5 plants one coin, each further $5 can add one more. You can switch off any coin, and Sprouts won't buy it. At least one coin stays on. stORE starts at 10% of your split until you change it.

The Yield Manager is optional. When it is off, you set your own split. When it is on, it is automated software: once a day it reads live lending rates and tunes your split inside limits you set and limits in code. Sprouts routes new USDC and SOL lending to the best eligible venue. Once your lending money reaches $20, new money goes to a venue only if that keeps it at or under 60% of your lending. The coin list is fixed in code. The manager never sets the amount and never sells anything you hold.

Sprouts is not financial advice, not investment advice and not tax advice. Nothing in the app is a recommendation to buy or sell any asset. Tax reports are a record for your tax tool, not a filing.

Risks

  • Prices move. The dollar value of your garden can be lower than what you put in.
  • A lending venue can pause withdrawals when its pool is fully lent out. Your money stays yours, and Withdraw tells you when a pool is full.
  • Smart contract risk. Your money touches software we did not write: Kamino, Jupiter, Solana Mobile's staking program and the Pyth price feeds. It also touches the Sprouts program, which we wrote. A bug or exploit in any of them could lose money.
  • Venue access. Kamino restricts some regions on its own website. Sprouts deposits on-chain for you; check that using lending is allowed where you live.

Fees

Sprouts takes 0.5% of each planting, in USDC: inside the swap for a coin, and before the deposit for USDC or SOL lending. Sprouts takes nothing on interest or withdrawals. Sprouts pays the Solana network fee for each planting. Topping up USDC from SOL or another coin in your wallet is a swap through Jupiter that you sign. Sprouts takes no fee on it. Withdrawals you sign carry the usual small Solana network fee (about $0.001). The coin and lending receipt accounts in your wallet need a small one-time rent in SOL. When you link or re-link this phone's wallet or add USDC, the app shows the amount and it is paid from your wallet's SOL. If your SOL does not cover it, or an account is still missing when a planting runs, Sprouts pays it. Whoever paid it, the rent stays with the account, and you get it back if you empty and close it.

Pro covers the Yield Manager, automatic lending and tax reports. All three are included free during launch. If Pro becomes paid, we will tell you in the app at least 30 days before. If you do not subscribe, the manager turns off and new round-ups go to your coins; your lending positions stay yours, keep earning and can be withdrawn at any time.

Data we keep

We store your Seed Vault public key, your linked wallet addresses, your Genesis Token mint, the swap records used to compute your round-ups, your plantings, your withdrawals, your settings, your sign-in sessions and an activity log. We never see or store your private keys or seed phrases. Your phone's signatures happen inside its Seed Vault. Our server's planting key signs the daily pulls, within the limits above.

If you message us from the app, we keep your message and the email you give us so we can reply. We use that email only to answer you.

We do not sell your data and we do not share it with advertisers. To delete your data: revoke your wallets in Settings, then contact us and we delete your account and records.

If Sprouts shuts down

If Sprouts shuts down, planting stops. Everything in your garden stays in your own wallet. You can revoke the allowance on chain at any time. You can unstake SKR and withdraw lending with your own wallet, through the staking program and the venues directly, without Sprouts. After the 48 hours you send the final SKR step yourself.
